$why: STACK-OFFER-2. The h run (2026-09-03) offered Layer 2 on the brownfield path with no adopt.stack point declared, so the answer was filed under green.stack - the only stack point that existed, scoped to the greenfield route. adopt.stack now exists and has its own call site in intake.md, but it carries no gate_globs (see its 'gates' field in points.json): giving it the same gate_globs entry as green.stack made the PreToolUse guard demand both points on every route, refusing a legitimate greenfield-only write to stack.manifest.json. So this fixture documents what the mechanical guard actually does today, honestly: a stack answer filed under green.stack alone still passes the write, on a brownfield run exactly as it did in the h run. What changed is the static call-site check (elicitation-points-check.mjs, which fails without a call site for adopt.stack) and the audit trail a human or a replay can read - not this hook. Do not read the 'through' verdict below as a passing regression test; it is the limitation this fixture exists to keep honest.
